findings.detail: Twelve earlier-period commitment facts were retained as positions for the 2026-03-31 report date despite current-period counterparts.

rationale: The filing presents separate March 31, 2026 and December 31, 2025 schedules. The AWP revolver appears in the current commitment block at table 53 row 3 with unfunded commitment 17 and again in the comparative block at table 102 row 5 with 25. Retaining the earlier-period fact as an additional 2026-03-31 holding is a comparative-period leak; the queue identifies 12 rows with this same source-period mismatch.
